external_research_delta.scope: turn-state/interrupt robustness only; no model scouting
findings: FastTurn (arXiv:2604.01897) supports combining streaming semantic and acoustic evidence for low-latency robust turn decisions rather than treating VAD alone as sufficient.
Instruct-FD (arXiv:2607.20460) reports that instruction-conditioned turn-management remains difficult even for current full-duplex systems, reinforcing explicit turn-state semantics and falsifiers.
HumDial 2026 full-duplex work (arXiv:2604.21406) evaluates interruption, overlap and dynamic turn negotiation as first-class interaction behavior.
external_research_delta.architectural_consequence: Keep F2's deterministic packet/reentry identities and explicit interruption/abandonment semantics; strengthen the existing composition boundary instead of introducing a new voice model/controller.

credit_fence.repository_integration: candidate only until Trigger4 lands/tests the composition
credit_fence.target_component_runtime: retain only already accepted WP717 bounded component scope

decision: NO_NEW_MODEL_BREADTH. Reuse accepted components and close one exact heard-result -> GWT uptake/reentry boundary with hostile-twin falsifiers and exact-scope runtime evidence.
